content.short: Artano is the first truly community-curated NFT marketplace, where artists, collectors and curators decide the direction of the platform.
content.description:
Our mission is to provide emerging and established artists with a marketplace shaped by the community.

We have a strong focus on diversity and high quality art. The members of our Council of Curators come from 16 different countries, and they have various experience levels, artistic backgrounds and are there to represent the whole planet and bring global talent to Artano.

$ARTA is our governance token, giving the Artano community power to influence decision making and enabling the most active artists, collectors and curators to vote on the future direction of the Artano platform.
